questions.q: What was the mean absolute error for clay soil after calibration?
questions.answer: The mean absolute error for clay soil after calibration was **2.8 volumetric percent** [1].

questions.q: How much did each probe cost compared with a commercial TDR sensor?
questions.answer: Each probe cost **11 US dollars**, compared to **240 dollars** for a commercial TDR sensor [1].

questions.q: Why did clay soils show the largest error?
questions.answer: Clay soils showed the largest error because of the **salinity sensitivity** of the probe's dielectric measurement [1].

questions.q: What pressure should the T-90 hydraulic accumulator be recharged to, and with what gas?
questions.answer: The Model T-90 hydraulic accumulator should be recharged to **1,450 psi** using **dry nitrogen** [1].

questions.q: ¿Cuántos días por semana se puede teletrabajar?
questions.answer: Los empleados pueden teletrabajar hasta **tres días por semana**, siempre que cuenten con la aprobación de su responsable [1].

questions.q: How much does Ferrum reimburse for internet each month?
questions.answer: Ferrum Logística reimburses **35 euros** per month for internet expenses [1].

questions.q: What is the warranty period for imported parts?
questions.answer: The warranty period for all imported parts is **18 months** [1].

questions.q: Combien de jours pour retourner un produit ?
questions.answer: Les clients peuvent retourner un produit sous **trente jours** [1].

questions.q: How many requests per minute does the Team plan allow?
questions.answer: The Team plan allows **600** requests per minute [1].

questions.q: How long can laptops be kept, and what is the late fee?
questions.answer: Laptops must be returned within **30 days** [1], and late returns incur a daily fee of **5 dollars** [1].

questions.q: How much is due on invoice INV-7731?
questions.answer: The amount due on invoice INV-7731 is **4,860 dollars** [1].

questions.q: What is the Express rate for Zone B?
questions.answer: The Express rate for Zone B is **19.80 EUR** [1].

questions.q: Is there a surcharge on Express shipments?
questions.answer: Yes, a fuel surcharge of **4%** applies to all Express shipments [1].
